bundle.note: The bundle and its manifest are never committed (R45): scripts/build.mjs builds them into dist/ by the recipe in bio-plane/scripts/fleet-bundle.mjs whenever a test, a deployment or a release needs them; the manifest states the artifact's sha256 and the sha256 of every input. THREE of this member's six build inputs are ../bio-plane/src/* (pdfstructure, subresources, cpu), so a change to the PLANE stales this artifact.

note: The fleet-member marker. bio-plane/scripts/fleet-bundle.mjs discovers a fleet member by this file and builds and verifies its `bundle`; the suites in `testDir` are run by the package's own `npm test`. `surface` names the member's declared surface table in `entry` (fleet rule 2: no surface op may declare `mutating: true`).
